meta.description: Common questions about ReadyKare — healthcare staffing for facilities and professionals in Canada.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about how ReadyKare works for healthcare teams and professionals.

items.question: What is ReadyKare?
items.answer: ReadyKare connects Canadian healthcare facilities with pre-screened, credentialed professionals for temporary staffing, home care, and relief coverage. We focus on fast matching and compliance so you can fill shifts without long hiring cycles.

items.question: Who can use ReadyKare?
items.answer: Healthcare organizations and facilities can post staffing needs. Licensed and credentialed professionals (nurses, PSWs, allied health, and more) can create a profile and apply to opportunities that match their skills and availability.

items.question: How does matching work?
items.answer: Facilities describe the role, dates, and requirements. We surface candidates from our vetted pool based on credentials, experience, and availability. Workers can also browse and apply to open roles that fit their preferences.

items.question: Is there a cost to create an account?
items.answer: You can create an account and explore the platform at no upfront cost. Pricing for facilities and optional upgrades for professionals are described in our pricing section when you sign in.

items.question: How are credentials verified?
items.answer: We collect and verify professional licenses, certifications, and other requirements according to your role and provincial rules. Exact steps are shown during onboarding so you always know what's needed.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: We handle personal information in line with Canadian privacy law (including PIPEDA where applicable). We only share what's necessary for placements, and you can read more in our Privacy Policy.

items.question: Do you operate outside Ontario?
items.answer: We're focused on Ontario healthcare staffing today. If you're elsewhere in Canada, you can still reach out — we'll let you know when coverage expands.

items.question: How do I get help?
items.answer: Use the contact options in the footer or email us at info@readykare.ca. For account-specific issues, sign in and use in-app support where available.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How ReadyKare collects, uses, and protects personal information for temporary healthcare staffing in Canada.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: A short, plain-language summary of how ReadyKare handles personal information as we match healthcare facilities with temporary staff.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: ReadyKare Inc. ("ReadyKare", "we", "us") runs a temporary healthcare staffing platform that matches Canadian healthcare facilities with pre-screened, credentialed professionals.

This policy explains what personal information we collect, what we do with it, and the rights you have. We handle personal information in line with Canadian privacy law, including PIPEDA and applicable provincial equivalents.

sections.title: What we collect

groups.heading: From professionals
bullets: Name, contact details, and location
Credentials, licenses, and relevant work history
Availability and shift preferences
Payroll details needed to pay you

groups.heading: From facilities
bullets: Organization details and authorized contacts
Staffing requests (role, dates, requirements)
Billing and invoicing information

groups.heading: From visitors
bullets: Basic technical data (IP, browser, pages visited)
Anything you voluntarily share in a form or email

sections.note: We only collect what we need to run the platform and staff shifts.

sections.title: How we use it
bullets: Verify credentials and eligibility to work
Match professionals with facility requests
Coordinate schedules, placements, and payroll
Respond to questions and provide support
Meet our legal and regulatory obligations

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share only what's necessary: with facilities to confirm a placement, with regulators or colleges to verify credentials, and with trusted service providers (payroll, background checks, hosting) acting on our behalf under confidentiality terms.
We disclose information to authorities when required by law or a valid legal process.
sections.note: We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable, industry-standard safeguards — encryption in transit, access controls, and secure hosting — proportionate to the sensitivity of the data.
If a breach occurs that poses a real risk of significant harm, we will notify you and the appropriate authorities.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, correct, or delete your personal information and withdraw consent where it applies.
Email privacy@readykare.ca and we will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information for as long as we need it to provide our services and to meet legal or tax obligations, then securely delete or anonymize it.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: As ReadyKare grows, this policy may change. We will update the "last updated" date and, for material changes, notify you directly.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The plain-language ground rules for using ReadyKare, whether you're a healthcare professional picking up shifts or a facility requesting staff.

sections.title: Your agreement with us
paragraphs: These Terms govern your use of readykare.ca and our staffing services (the "Services"). By using the Services, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
If you are accepting on behalf of an organization, you confirm you have authority to bind it. If you don't agree to these Terms, please don't use the Services.

sections.title: What we do
paragraphs: ReadyKare is a temporary healthcare staffing platform. We help Canadian facilities fill shifts with pre-screened, credentialed professionals, and we help those professionals find suitable placements.
We match, coordinate, and (where applicable) handle payroll for the placements we arrange.

sections.title: Your account
bullets: Give us accurate, up-to-date information
Keep your login credentials secure
You're responsible for activity on your account

sections.title: For professionals
bullets: Hold and maintain valid credentials for the work you accept
Follow the policies, procedures, and professional standards of the facility you're placed in
Let us know right away if your licence, availability, or eligibility changes
Don't use ReadyKare to circumvent placements (e.g. soliciting direct hire from a facility you met through us)

sections.title: For facilities
bullets: Give accurate details about the shift, setting, and any known hazards
Follow applicable health and safety laws for staff working on your site
Pay invoices on the terms set out in your agreement with us

sections.title: Acceptable use
bullets: No false, misleading, or fraudulent submissions
No unauthorized access, scraping, or automated abuse
No conduct that undermines the safety or integrity of the platform

sections.title: Disclaimers & limits
paragraphs: We make reasonable efforts to screen professionals and to fill requests, but we don't guarantee placements or specific outcomes.
Clinical decisions during a shift remain the professional responsibility of the individual and the facility. ReadyKare is not a clinical care provider.
sections.note: To the extent permitted by law, ReadyKare's total liability in connection with the Services is limited to the fees you've paid us in the three months before the claim.

sections.title: Changes & termination
paragraphs: We may update these Terms as the platform evolves. We'll post the revised date and, for material changes, notify you directly.
We may also suspend or end access for anyone who misuses the Services.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Ontario.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms? Email legal@readykare.ca.
